en:
"*Cough, hack*...{w}As you can see, I'm an invalid... *cough*.{w}And yet they claimed I was faking it to slack off... *hack*"{w}{p}"...Even if I were faking, don't you think
throwing me in jail is cruel?"{w}
note: Speaker name box (row 1262, slice_015) = byoujaku na kenkaku, "sickly swordsman". byounin rendered "invalid" to avoid gendering ("sick man").

en: There are old documents and history books here.{w}

There are old documents and history books here.
You found something among them.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Sun Prison Shrine.{w}
note: New item: Sun Prison Shrine (zushi = small shrine cabinet; "you lot" opens it and a doll is inside). ITEM_PRIZ max 18; 17 chars.

en:
When you opened the Sun Prison Shrine,
a small fairy doll came out from inside.{w}{p}It looked as if someone had made it by hand.{w}You gently put the doll back in its box.{w}
Summer
note: Ninja rank/monster name (katakana samaa; MON_TEXT: "a ninja holding the title of Samaa"). Romanized as Summer; tentative.

en:
"If you find a log lying in the forest,{w}it may be the trace of a ninja
who used the Substitution Technique..."{w}
note: kawarimi no jutsu = Substitution Technique (ninja swaps self for a log).

en: Kannagi
note: Monster name (shrine-medium type), romanized.

en: "Truth is, if you peel back that wall, behind it{w}the whole surface is plastered with talismans...{w}Hmm, whatever happened here long ago?"{w}
Tenko
note: Monster name tenko (celestial fox), romanized like Kannagi/Hatamoto. Alternative: "Celestial Fox".

en: "Yes, this place is a fine one to dwell in after all.{w}Other lands are noisy somehow -- it simply won't do.{w}A den ought to be quiet."{w}
Hatamoto
note: Monster name (samurai banner-bearer), romanized.

en: "My katana's gone rusty..."{w}
"You haven't been looking after it properly, have you?{w}At least it wasn't a Muramasa, right?"{w}
note: Muramasa = the famous katana item. Kannagi teases Hatamoto: at least the rusted blade was not a Muramasa. | Editorial: 'Better that than if it were a Muramasa' was hard to parse; now says plainly that at least the rusted blade was not a Muramasa.

en:
"...Like a Muramasa would ever turn up.{w}How many dozens of hours have I spent hunting for one...?"{w}{p}"If only I could use a spear one-handed,
things might be a little better.{w}...Wait, you can?"{w}
note: Meta joke about farming the Muramasa drop. Last line: someone (unseen) tells him spears can be one-handed; kept as "Wait, you can?".

en: Asunamuchi
note: New name (10 dupes). Romanized literally; possibly modeled on Onamuchi. Glossary gender unknown; speech uses archaic feminine "warawa" but no pronouns used for her.

Source title is ten-jou ma-ryoku (green), almost certainly a typo for ma-en (fiend/devil) as in ITEM_PRIZ 26:4 "Tenjou Maen Asunamuchi"; translated "the Heavenly Fiend". Between pages the party evidently fails to introduce itself. daichi no tami = "folk of the land" (daichi = "the land" per pilot). Archaic-noble register for her throughout.
Miasuna = castle/dungeon name (written with kanji + ruby "Miasuna"; DGN_NAME uses katakana Miasuna). Ruby dropped.

en: "............By the way.{w}Lately there has been some racket outside..........."{w}{p}"You lot, go and have a look for me.{w}I shall wait here at my leisure.{w}I expect something amusing, mind."{w}
note: "tokini" (written with the kanji for time) read as "by the way".

en: "...How long do you mean to keep me waiting? Make haste.{w}The land will perish at this rate, you know?{w}Ohohohohoho!"{w}

"Ohohohoho!{w}Alive! They're alive!
This lot actually came back alive!"{w}{p}"Well?{w}Tell me all of it, from beginning to end."{w}
note: Editorial: 'These ones' was unidiomatic; 'this lot' matches Asunamuchi's 'you lot' elsewhere.

en: You told Asunamuchi about the whole affair.{w}

"Truly, truly? Is that so?{w}Ohohohohoho!"{w}{p}"Who'd have thought it -- mere people of the land!
My, how hard you strove!
You went beyond my every expectation!"{w}{p}"Yes, this is just how amusement
ought to be.{w}When one can see through everything, it is so dull."{w}{p}"Ohohohohohohoho!{w}I have not laughed like this in ages,
ohohohohohohoho!"{w}{p}"Mm, I am satisfied.
You may withdraw now."{w}

note: "aite wo sei" = be my partner/opponent; it leads to a fight, so "play with me" keeps both the idle and the menacing reading. Paired with choice row 1287.

en: Play with Asunamuchi?
note: Choice prompt (aite wo shimasu ka). Named instead of "her" (gender not in glossary). 21 chars.

en: "Ohohohoho!!{w}What a spirited reply -- splendid indeed.{w}Don't you lot go dying on me too soon, now."{w}

"Ohohohoho!{w}Delightful! Truly delightful!"{w}{p}"You lot are about the only ones
who have ever amused me this much.{w}Ohohohoho!!"{w}
note: Presumably after the party wins the fight.

en: "Is that so...{w}How truly... dull..."{w}
note: Refusal branch.

en: Evil Magistrate
note: akudaikan, the stock corrupt magistrate of period dramas. 15 chars.

en:
"...Who goes there?{w}Were you drawn here by the scent
of these golden 'sweets' of mine?"{w}{p}"What? You've come to bring me to justice?{w}Amusing... All of you! Intruders!{w}Cut them down! Cut them to pieces!!"{w}
note: yamabuki-iro no okashi = the period-drama bribe: gold coins hidden in a box of sweets. Quotes around 'sweets' signal the euphemism.

en: "You may have beaten me, but it's already too late...{w}Heh heh heh heh...{w}
note: Source has no closing quote here (row 1294 continues the same line); kept unclosed.
{0E}..{0F} re-shows row 1293 text verbatim.

en: You brought the Evil Magistrate to justice!{w}{p}But your joy was short-lived --{w}you sensed some kind of evil presence.{w}{p}The presence vanished in an instant,{w}leaving only an eerie silence behind.{w}
Jailer
"You there! What are you doing!?"{w}
"Blast you, you lowly curs!!{w}But I'll tolerate no lawlessness here in Meiroin!!{w}Begone!!"{w}
note: Meirouin = Miasuna dungeon section (DGN_NAME "Miasuna Meirouin"); it is the prison block, so "Meirou Prison". New term, tentative. | Editorial: 'Curse ... curs' made an accidental sound echo.

en: Samurai
"Intruuuuders!{w}Suspicious rogues! Seize theeeem!!"{w}

Without a sound, a ninja appeared before you.{w}Ninja: a band of assassins that arose in the East,
each of them said to be a weapon from head to toe.{w}{p}Make one careless move or let your gaze wander,
and your head could easily go flying.{w}{p}But you, too, are seasoned adventurers.{w}Gauging each other's strength,
you inch closer, closing the distance.{w}{p}The breathless standoff continues.{w}The moment either side's breathing falters,
the fight will begin.{w}{p}............{w}
note: Kept the source shift into the present tense for the standoff. | Editorial: 'a band ... whose every inch' attached the body to the band; now attached to each member.

en: Ninja

note: Build-up to the sneeze in 1304.

en: "...AH-CHOOOOOO!!"{w}

note: i-ma-da ("now!") spelled out syllable by syllable; narration urging the party to strike.

en: A flower made of crystal is blooming here.{w}
A flower made of crystal is blooming here.{w}
note: Same text as 1306 (source only drops the final period).

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Crystal Flower.{w}
note: Crystal Flower as in wmap slice_06 (Zeppo quest).

en: The crystal here is a different color from the rest.{w}
Beyond the thick fog, you sensed someone's presence.{w}The presence took human shape and slowly drew closer.{w}
Stay where you are?

The thing drawing closer, step by step,
had much the same build as you.{w}{p}Much the same?{w}{p}No -- what had appeared was you yourselves.{p}
note: Source ends with {p} not preceded by {w}; kept as is. Doppelganger encounter (EVENT_TEXT 43:8).

en:
With a bitter aftertaste,
you left that place.{w}
Something is lying here.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Vision Crystal.{w}
note: New item genshi no kesshou = Vision Crystal (material for the observatory, Mayleen event). 14 chars.

en: You left that place.{w}

A mysterious girl appeared before you.{w}Perhaps this was her usual route -- even on seeing you,
she kept coming without the slightest hesitation.{w}{p}When she was right in front of you, the girl knit her brows
as though it were all a great nuisance,
and made a small brushing-away gesture with her hand.{w}
note: shoujo = girl (gender given by source). EVENT_TEXT 39:8 mentions a short blue-haired girl deep in the Crystal Labyrinth; identity not stated here, left as "girl".

en: "...Move. You're in the way."{w}
Step aside?

When you made way,
the girl walked off as if nothing had happened.{w}

When you held your ground and refused to make way,
the girl gave a small sigh.{w}
"...Honestly."{w}

As though shooing away a dog,
the girl waved her hand at you: shoo, shoo.{w}{p}You fled for your lives.{w}
note: "at you" added for clarity; the gesture plainly targets the party.

Presumably after the party beats her. majutsushi = Mage (glossary). The stretched "yooku" rendered as a pause. | Editorial: 'Remember that... well.' could read as a resigned 'oh well' (accuracy report item 5). The drawn-out yooku is kept as emphasis.

en:
The girl's eyes gleamed.
Your bodies floated up into the air, and then...{w}

In a cave filled with light,
a strange skull was flying through the air.{w}{p}Its pure-white wings somehow called light itself to mind.{w}The noble, radiant winged skull, seemingly not of this world,
flitted through the air, scattering motes of light.{w}{p}Bone though it was,
its shining white form gave off not a trace of malice.{w}If anything, it even exuded a holy air.{w}

"Ugh, what a draaag, maaan...{w}We could just leave Zaalhaut alone,
couldn't we? Jeez~"{w}
The holy air was just your imagination.{w}

"Even after getting the Beldoll,
Zaalhaut never answered the call in the first place, right?"{w}{p}"And far from answering -- tossing away one of the
strongest Arguments there is? That's nuts.
Just what you'd expect from Zanu's daughter."{w}{p}"Sure, like the report said, it looks like
the Beldoll's been revived in Finas Rade, but..."{w}{p}"I really can't see Zaalhaut trying anything
on us at this point... Huh?"{w}
note: Subject of "never answered" and "do anything to us" omitted in source; restored as Zaalhaut (topic of the previous row; the skull is looking for Zaalhaut). "Zanuu's daughter" may therefore refer to Zaalhaut -- no pronoun used. Beldoll = seichirin Beldoll, an Argument (MON_TEXT 316); Argument = seisengu (selection relic for the Librarian). "the call" = the Argument summoning its bearer to the Mechanism. Accuracy: Zanuu -> Zanu (glossary spelling; the same wicked mage Zanu named as Zaalhaut's parent in g5 row 1703). Source here writes the name with a trailing small u.

en: The weird bone noticed you.{w}
"Yo! Is Zaalhaut anywhere around...{w}Ah, crap!{w}I wasn't supposed to talk to anybody!!"{w}
The weird bone is panicking all by itself.{w}

"Ohhh, wh-what do I do?
Lord Hevayur's gonna chew me ouuut!{w}Hey, you! What am I supposed to... do!?"{w}
note: Source has Hevayur-sama; honorific dropped because Lord/Lady would need a gender not in the glossary (MON_TEXT 324 calls Hevayur a man -- if accepted, "Lord Hevayur" restores the deference). Accuracy: restored the -sama deference as 'Lord' (glossary now lists Hevayur as male).

en: There's nothing in particular you can do to help.{w}

"Nngh... Th-then I've got no choice
but to... wipe you out!!{w}Sorry, I'm so sorryyy!!"{w}
"Ow! That hurts, you bastard!!{w}You'll pay for this, dammit!!"{w}
The weird bone ran off.{w}
Some worn-out old junk has been left here.{w}
Some worn-out old junk has been left here.{w}Looking closely, you see it is labeled Proof of Endurance.{w}
note: New item nintai no akashi = Proof of Endurance (18 chars, ITEM_PRIZ max 18).

en: Swap with Proof of Training?
note: New item tanren no akashi = Proof of Training. 27 chars. Accuracy: 'swap for X' read as receiving X; the player gives up the Proof of Training (row 1341) and takes the Proof of Endurance (row 1342). 28 chars.

en: You set down the Proof of Training.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Proof of Endurance.{w}
The Proof of Training lies here.{w}
note: tanren no akashi -> 'Proof of Training' (new item name; pairs with 'Proof of Endurance' for nintai no akashi in slice_016 rows 1339/1342 and chap slice_014 rows 1113-1116, not yet translated -- keep both names in step). State after the player has swapped it in (row 1341).

en: Ore lies scattered about.{w}
Rocks lie strewn all over the place.{w}
Take some?
note: Yes/no prompt after rows 1344/1345; follows the corpus pattern 'Take it?' but plural to suit ore/rocks.

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Medium Whetstone.{w}
note: Item name from wmap slice_11 (blacksmith quest: Medium Whetstone / Finishing Whetstone).

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Fine Whetstone.{w}
note: See row 1347.

en: There's a hole here.{w}

note: Floor Master scene, Rinos Undersea Volcano centre (a reaper-type monster; the script never names it). Narrator's ironic present tense in pages 4-5 ('there is no need to worry... it will all be over') kept as present, the rest past. 'ato suukoku inai' (within a few koku) rendered 'in a matter of moments' for the dramatic sense.

en: The temperature around you rose sharply.{w}Everything seethed, and it felt as if your bodies might come apart.{w}{p}A face slowly loomed into view, a tongue flickering in and out.{w}A Salamander, a dragon of blazing flame, had appeared.{w}
note: Floor Master scene, Rinos Undersea Volcano (Volk). 'Salamander' is the standard katakana reading.

en: You stepped into a certain room in the Palace of the Sun.{w}Necrophilis was there, looking rather disgruntled.{w}
"Why do I, of all people, have to play guard dog!?{w}That braid-head really pisses me off!"{w}
note: 'ano mitsuami' = 'that braid' -- someone with braided hair who gave Necrophilis this order; the referent is not named in this scene (possibly Dark Mayer). Kept as a nickname insult.

en:
"Still, this Palace of the Sun...{w}there's some seriously nasty energy
pouring in here, more and more of it."{w}{p}"...Hey, Narv!!"{w}
note: New name: Narv (naruvu).

en: Narv
note: New name (romanized naruvu); gender unknown, no pronouns used.

en: "Just what are you trying to make me do!?{w}It's about time you told me what Mayer's up to!"{w}
"Keep this up and I'll turn you into a corpse too, got it!?"{w}
"...Try it, if you are able."{w}
note: Narv speaks in spaced katakana throughout (an inhuman, stilted voice). Rendered as stiff, contraction-free English; no special casing.

en:
"......I bear the form of Narv, yet I am not
the Narv of the Real Axis.{w}We are the Spirit of the Dark Realm: Numbra Narv."{w}
note: New terms: jitsusuuki -> 'Real Axis' (its counterpart kyosuuki, slice_018 rows 1445/1457, would be 'Void Axis'); Numbra Narv (nunbura naruvu; cf. Numbra Malem in slice_018). ankiki = 'Dark Realm' as in wmap slice_20. 'Ware wa... warera koso' -- I/We shift kept.

en: "What are you... talking about..."{w}
"The enemy is here, Necrophilis. Intercept them.{w}Do not let them near the Zenith Arc."{w}{p}"Should you fail,{w}it is you who will become the corpse."{w}
note: kantenchou aaku = circumzenithal arc (the real optical phenomenon); capitalised as a place/object name. 'kisama no hou ga shitai ni narou' answers Necrophilis's threat in row 1357.

en: "Every damn one of you, treating me like a joke!!"{w}
note: Necrophilis drops into rough masculine speech from here (-yagatte, nee, temee); English roughened to match.

en: "Screw that!{w}Like I'd take orders from you bastards...{w}Take orders... from... dammit...!"{w}{p}"I just have to kill them, right?{w}Kill these guys and you'll be satisfied, right...{w}
note: Page 2 opens a quote that the source does not close here; it continues in row 1366 (no closing quote added).
{0E}..{0F} re-shows row 1365 page 2 word for word.
Wordless scream; long dash rendered as '--------'. No {w} in source.

en:
Face twisted with rage and sorrow,
Necrophilis came at you!{w}
"Gaaah!{w}...I never thought you'd gotten this strong..."{w}

Propping up a body covered in wounds,
Necrophilis staggered, trying to stand.{w}
"...Enough."{w}

"Narv...{w}You idiot... Coming to back me up now?
You're way too damn late..."{w}
note: Necrophilis misreads Narv's 'Enough' (row 1371) as Narv stepping in to help; row 1373 corrects her.

en: "What makes you think that?"{w}
note: 'Nani o kanchigai shite iru?' -- Narv is not here to help; followed by the lightning strike. | Editorial: 'What are you mistaking this for?' was unidiomatic. Narv rebuffs Necrophilis's belief that Narv came to help (kanchigai); question form kept.

en: "GYAAAAAAAAH!!{w}Hh... ha... aagh..."{w}

Necrophilis was struck by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}{p}Once-white skin was charred black, clothes and all,
and dark smoke rose from Necrophilis's throat.{w}Then, slowly, Necrophilis crumpled to the ground.{w}
note: Pronouns avoided by repeating the name (glossary gender unknown), though row 1378 calls Necrophilis 'the demon girl' (akuma no shoujo).

en: "Discard it? Though time is short..."{w}
note: Narv weighing whether to throw away Necrophilis's body. 'it' reflects Narv treating Necrophilis as a tool (no pronoun in source).

en:
"It still breathes, barely.{w}It failed this time, but we shall have it
do one more job elsewhere."{w}
note: See row 1376. 'saseru to shiyou' -- Narv's collective 'we' supplied (Narv refers to itself as warera/wareware).

en:
A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}Without so much as a twitch, the demon girl
was swallowed into the bottomless abyss...{w}
note: 'Naruvu-tachi' -> 'Narv and the others' (corpus pattern for X-tachi). Who the others are is unclear: Narv speaks as 'we', so this may be Narv's own multiple bodies plus Necrophilis. 'akuma no shoujo' = 'the demon girl' (source wording; first explicit gender cue for Necrophilis).

en:
"We, too, are short on time.{w}If you mean to stand in our way, come prepared
to meet the same fate."{w}

Leaving those ominous words behind,
Narv and the others departed.{w}
note: Dupes 2. 'Naruvu-tachi' as in row 1378.

en: "You too shall join the ranks of the dead."{w}
note: Alternative branch (rows 1381-1393), apparently after Emera's Soul Therapy: the corpses shield Necrophilis instead.

en: "Me... a corpse?"{w}

"...Maybe that wouldn't be so bad.
In the end, I could never belong to this world anyway..."{w}
note: 'kono sekai to wa majiwarenai' -- echoes 'I could never fit into this world' (chap slice_008 row 604).

en:
As if to shield Necrophilis's wounded body from view,
the corpses rose up as one horde.{w}

"Dead things... What do you think you are doing,
you will-less husks?"{w}

"...Emera, maybe that hocus-pocus of yours
worked after all."{w}{p}"...If you guys are going to protect me..."{w}
note: 'majinai' -> 'hocus-pocus', Necrophilis's own word for Soul Therapy in chap slice_008 row 599. Page 2 'antatachi' = the corpses; the sentence finishes in row 1388.

en: "...then I want to live."{w}
note: Completes row 1387 page 2 ('...if you'll protect me' / '...I want to live'); cut kept at the row boundary. Reverses 'I don't want to live' (slice_008 row 606).

en: "Corpses will not serve even as a shield."{w}

The writhing horde of the dead was swept away by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}But where the dead had stood as a wall,
Necrophilis was nowhere to be seen.{w}
"Do not think you can escape..."{w}

A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}The silenced corpses, now one black mass,
were swallowed into the bottomless abyss...{w}

"We, too, are short on time.{w}If you mean to stand in our way, come prepared:
we will show no mercy."{w}
note: Branch variant of row 1379 (yousha wa shinai instead of onaji me ni au).

en: The wounded Sun God appeared before you.{w}
note: taiyoushin = 'Sun God' (the people's name for Rafa, see row 1395); distinct from taiyousei 'Sun Spirit'.

en:
"It's nice to meet you, everyone...{w}I'm sorry... to appear like this.{w}I am... the Sun Spirit... Rafa."{w}{p}"The people of the land...{w}call me the Sun God, but..."{w}{p}"I'm nothing... so grand... as a god...{w}Just a spirit... who happened to be suited for it."{w}{p}"Thank you...{w}for taking back the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"Now, once again...
I can give everyone... light...{w}Ngh... uugh..."{w}
note: Pages 4-5 must stay identical to row 1397. 'tekisei ga atta dake' = merely had the aptitude (to become the Sun Spirit; cf. slice_019 row 1577, where Zaalhaut made Rafa the Sun Spirit).

en:
With that, the Sun Spirit Rafa lost consciousness.{w}{p}There was still something left for you to do.{w}{p}Was there no way to save the wounded
Sun Spirit Rafa...?{w}
note: Dupes 2.

en:
"Thank you...{w}for taking back the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"Now, once again...
I can give everyone... light...{w}Ngh... uugh..."{w}
note: Identical to row 1395 pages 4-5 (repeat-visit version).

en:
You held up the Light Rank you had obtained
in the Sanctum of Genesis.{w}
note: New terms: seisouken -> 'Holy Creation Sphere' (the place where Zaalhaut made Rafa the Sun Spirit, slice_019 rows 1574-1585); kouI -> 'Light Rank' (later 'taiyou no kouI', slice_021 row 1720, would be 'Sun's Light Rank'; the I/'rank' is gathered from the Qualia and taken to a coronation chamber, slice_020 row 1643). Both are tentative.
{0E}..{0F} re-shows row 1398 word for word. 'True Crystal' from wmap slice_02.

en: "Rafa!"{w}
"Yorfa!"{w}{p}"Yorfa...{w}I made you worry so much too, didn't I?"{w}

"Thank goodness...{w}Rafa... I'm so, so glad..."{w}{p}"I was so worried about you, Rafa,
I wanted to save you, and that's why I..."{w}
note: Yorfa addresses Rafa in the third person ('Raafa no koto'); rendered 'you, Rafa' as in wmap slice_02.

en: "It's all right now, Yorfa.{w}Everything has been resolved.{w}All thanks to these adventurers."{w}
"Mm... Thank you, adventurers.{w}Thank you for saving Rafa..."{w}{p}"I..."{w}
note: Trailing 'I...' kept unfinished.

en: Zaalhaut
"A storybook happy ending if ever I saw one.{w}Well, it's all thanks to me, naturally.{w}You'd better be grateful, you lot."{w}
note: Zaalhaut (washi, omaera): gruff, self-important sage.

en:
Before you knew it, a battered, ragged Zaalhaut
was standing behind you.{w}
"Hm? What's with that baffled look?{w}As if I'd kick the bucket over a little thing like that."{w}
note: Leading full-width '?' rendered 'Hm?'.

en: "Not me, the great sage Zaalhaut!"{w}
note: Completes row 1410 ('washi ga... kutabaru wake ga nakarou' / 'kono kenja Zaaruhauto ga na!'). 'great' added for the emphatic kono.

en:
The light of the Palace of the Sun was more beautiful than ever.{w}It seemed to foretell the future of this land,
and of all the people who live upon it.{w}
"Everyone, thank you so very much."{w}
You stepped into a certain room in the Palace of the Sun.{w}{p}Shaharon was there, wearing a cruel smile.{w}

note: 'Meiyaa-sama' -> 'Master Mayer' (honorific; gender-neutral choice). Row 1415 is not in this slice (already translated elsewhere).

en:
"......Shaharon. You too were once a spirit,
the same as Yorfa and that lot."{w}
note: 'Yoruha-domo' (contemptuous plural) -> 'Yorfa and that lot'; Shaharon was originally a spirit like Yorfa (Moonlight Spirit) and Rafa.

en:
"...Then fulfill your duty
as a trusted right hand."{w}{p}"Shaharon, do not let them near
the Zenith Arc."{w}{p}"Should you fail,
it is your own death
you will be touching."{w}
note: Last page turns Shaharon's 'touching death' (row 1418) back on Shaharon.

en:
"Very well."{w}{p}"Now, adventurers.
Let me hear you lament your ruin."{w}

With a heartless laugh,
Shaharon came at you!{w}

"Ngh!
...To think you would drive me this far..."{w}

Letting out a dreadful groan,
Shaharon staggered toward you.{w}
"...Useless."{w}
note: Narv speaks in stilted katakana in the source; rendered terse and formal throughout, no contractions.

en:
"Ngh..."{w}{p}"Wait.
Not yet... I...!"{w}
note: Shaharon pleading as Narv turns on it; "mada... watashi wa..." trails off.

en: "Receive judgment."{w}

"Ugoooh!!
...Gwaaargh...!"{w}
Shaharon was struck by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}{p}Dark smoke rose from Shaharon's body in countless trails, and those two long arms crumpled to the floor, robes and all.{w}
note: No pronoun for Shaharon (gender unknown): "its two long arms" -> "those two long arms".

en:
"Let us go and dispose
of the useless one."{w}
note: sutete yuku ka: Narv deciding to dump Shaharon (cf. chap 1376, same verb for Necrophilis).

en: A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}The spirit who had drowned in the power of darkness was swallowed into the bottomless abyss along with Narv, leaving no trace...{w}

here you come right on cue. Such is my genius!{w}Hey, paint's not supposed to run away, got it?"{w}

en: Old Man
"Welcome, from so very far away.{w}You must be weary. Do come in, please."{w}
"There's still some of the pie I baked this morning.{w}Do you like meat pie?{w}I'll warm it up for you right now."{w}
note: Speaker roubaa (Old Woman; its name row is translated elsewhere).

en: You heard singing.{w}The singer was drawing steadily closer.{w}{p}You couldn't even tell what language it was in,{w}yet you could recognize it as a 'song.'{w}For whom was he singing?{w}{p}The song grew louder still,{w}and you were swallowed up by it.{w}

en: How should one even describe him?{w}By any measure, a mollusk.{w}And yet you sensed a tremendous charisma.{w}{p}Clattering the countless arrows that ran through his head as if they were fangs,{w}he spoke to you like a friend of ten-odd years.{w}
note: Source says yumi (bows) piercing the head; rendered "arrows" because the bestiary (MON_TEXT 312) says the things in its head are arrows (ya) from a fight with Polyte, and bows cannot pierce a head. "him/he" from the source (kare).

When you reached the Sanctum of Genesis,
Zaalhaut was waiting for you, looking impatient.{w}
note: New term: seisouken = "Sanctum of Genesis" (sei holy + sou creation + ken sphere; 18 chars, fits the DGN_NAME dungeon-name max of 18).

en: "Just how long do you intend to keep ME waiting!?"{w}
note: kono washi wo = "me, of all people" -> stressed ME.

en:
"Listen well. There is something
I need you to obtain."{w}{p}"Defeat every one of the Qualia that guard
this Sanctum of Genesis, and claim their ranks."{w}{p}"Bear those ranks into the Coronation Hall,
and you can gain the Sun's Light Rank."{w}{p}"With the Sun's Light Rank,
Rafa can be made a true Sun Spirit."{w}{p}"Come on, let's get moving.
We can't stay here for long, you know."{w}
note: New terms: kuoria = "Qualia" (Red/Blue/... Qualia in EL_KIRO/MONSTER3; used as a count noun, same form singular and plural); kurai = "rank"; taikan no ma = "Coronation Hall"; taiyou no koui = "the Sun's Radiant Rank"; taiyousei = Sun Spirit (existing). Last page identical to row 1644 on purpose.

en:
"Come on, let's get moving.
We can't stay here for long, you know."{w}
note: Same source text as the last page of row 1643; English kept identical.

en:
"This is the Sanctum of Genesis, ruled by the Light of All Knowledge.{w}Beings such as you
will not be permitted to go one step further."{w}{p}"Let me say this at the outset:
there is no room whatsoever for discussion.{w}You will be eliminated without delay."{w}{p}"Entering this place,
having come this far at all --
that alone warrants elimination."{w}{p}"Commencing elimination.{w}Be burned by the holy light, and vanish."{w}
note: No speaker name (6 reuses; likely the Qualia guardians). New term: banchi no hikari = "the Light of All Knowledge". Cold, formal register.

whose soles are soiled with mud."{w}

Opinion Bit

"...Oh? How very odd.{w}You came to the Sanctum of Genesis last time as well, did you not?"{w}{p}"Why would you try to throw away
the life you were lucky enough to keep?"{w}
note: Addressed to Zaalhaut (anata written with the female kanji in the source; English "you" needs no gender). hirotta inochi = a life narrowly saved.

"I see. So this time you mean to use these people as a shield to reach the Coronation Hall."{w}
note: sono monodomo = slightly disdainful "those ones"; kept neutral as "these people".

en:
"No, you're wrong, Opinion Bit.{w}I'm the one who'll be dealing with you lot.
They're the ones heading to the Coronation Hall."{w}
note: omaetachi = the Opinion Bits (plural, there are several) -> "you lot".

en:
"Allow me to confirm: you were nearly killed
by us once before, were you not?"{w}
"Aye, that's right. What of it?"{w}
note: "sono toori da ga" -- trailing "ga" (but...) rendered as "What of it?".

en: "Please wait a moment."{w}

note: Parallel narration in slice_021 row 1668 ("again..."); keep the wording aligned there.

en:
"..........{w}...We have reached the conclusion that this cannot be understood."{w}{p}"We will set this topic aside.{w}Now, let us proceed with your elimination.
And after that, everyone behind you."{w}
note: gidai wo kaihi shimasu = "We will set this topic aside" -- recurs in slice_021 rows 1669 and 1676; keep the same wording. Speaking to Zaalhaut; "sono ushiro no minasama" = the party.

en: Magic power enough to make you freeze in your tracks began to gather around the Opinion Bits.{w}
"Opinion Bit."{w}
note: Vocative "Opinion Bit yo" -- a calm call for attention before the riddle.

en: "Yes? What is it?"{w}
"The longer it grows, the closer it gets to the ground...{w}Do you know what it is?"{w}
note: Riddle; answer "Hair" comes in slice_021 row 1670. Worded so "hair" works as the answer.
